4009-5226-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4009-5226-5660-6769.description:
Cast Mox Opal by paying its mana cost.
When Mox Opal enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mox Opal by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Mox Opal, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mox Opal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

2645-3430-5475-6256.easyPrerequisites: Forensic Researcher doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3430-5475-6256.description:
Activate Muraganda Raceway by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Muraganda Raceway
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

147-3905-6798.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3905-6798.description:
Cast Unbreakable Bond by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Unbreakable Bond.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Unbreakable Bond
Resolve the Unbreakable Bond copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

728-1510-4574-5849.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Arcbound Stinger.
When Arcbound Stinger dies, its modular ability triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Arcbound Stinger from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Arcbound Stinger from the top of your library by paying {0} due to Fortune Teller's Talent.
Repeat.

2232-7827-7829-7830.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7829-7830.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R/W}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6965-7796.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6965-7796.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Precinct Captain, triggering Breath of Fury and Precinct Captain.
Resolve the Precinct Captain trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

4381-5641-7306.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully, it triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that'll also enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token.
Activate the Mutagen by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that'll enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

1887-3099-4762-6774.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Loading Zone and Vorinclex.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

772-3175-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2292-4396-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2292-4396-4871-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1274-2034-4772-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1274-2034-4772-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

6848-6849-7046.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to proliferate or a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite after an opponent gains control of it.
6848-6849-7046.description:
Donate control of Bloodcrazed Hoplite to an opponent.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite either by proliferating or by any other method.
Bloodcrazed Hoplite triggers, targeting any creature controlled by you or another opponent.
When the opponent commits that crime, Patrolling Peacemaker triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

3963-5963-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
3963-5963-7009.description:
Activate Marvin using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Meneldor. Meneldor triggers, blinking Marvin.
Repeat each turn.

373-877-3634.description:
Cast Venser by paying {0}.
When Venser enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

527-1636-2034-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 1 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
527-1636-2034-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{U} plus an additional {X} equal to Sin's power minus 3.
When Sin enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sin, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters on Selvala.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3384-4050-4550-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
3384-4050-4550-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

2558-2921-6351--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-2921-6351--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Teval triggers. Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

372-3556-4477.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Flicker exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3556-4477.description:
Cast Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Greenwarden of Murasa and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Greenwarden of Murasa trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Flicker.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Greenwarden of Murasa and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Kiora's Follower and without summoning sickness

116-283-3455.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Vizier of Many Faces.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kiora's Follower's ability.
Resolve both Kiora's Follower abilities, untapping Vizier of Many Faces and another permanent you control.
Activate Vizier of Many Faces by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

1645-1765-2557-5231.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}, targeting any creature you control.
When Crown of Flames enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating two 2/2 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing the Spirits, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames' second ability by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1278-4508-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Lightning-Rig Crew.
Lightning-Rig Crew does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least three opponents.
1278-4508-5200.description:
Activate Lightning-Rig Crew by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Lightning-Rig Crew.
Repeat until you have two or less opponents remaining.

2034-3377-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrapwork Cohort, adding {C}{C}.
Scrapwork Cohort dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Scrapwork Cohort from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Scrapwork Cohort enters the battlefield, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Soldier token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

317-2034-4186.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
317-2034-4186.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
Mazirek triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

401-914-2438.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
401-914-2438.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
Dockside Extortionist dies, triggering Decaying Soil, causing you to pay {1} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

264-3681.notablePrerequisites:
Grafted Exoskeleton attached to Lord of Tresserhorn.
Lord of Tresserhorn does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Lord of Tresserhorn.
264-3681.description:
Deal combat damage with Lord of Tresserhorn, causing target opponent to get twelve poison counters.
The opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

1702-3212-4377.description:
Activate Jace's zero loyalty ability, putting Walk the Aeons on top of your library.
Move to your next turn.
On your next draw step, when you draw Walk the Aeons, reveal it due to Kefnet's ability, making a copy that costs {2} less to cast.
Cast the copy for {2}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn.

1992-2034-4381.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
1992-2034-4381.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature with at least one +1/+1 counter, adding {C}{C}.
Basri's Lieutenant trigger, creating a 2/2 Knight token.
When Knight token enters the battlefield, Grumgully triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Knight token.
Repeat.
